libraries.name: US EPA Supply Chain GHG Emission Factors
libraries.basis: Cradle-to-gate supply-chain emissions per 2022 USD at purchaser price (with margins), by gas
libraries.citation: US EPA (2024). Supply Chain Greenhouse Gas Emission Factors v1.3 by NAICS-6. doi:10.23719/1531143
libraries.note: Adjust spend to 2022 USD for inflation. "HFCs and PFCs, unspecified" is pre-characterised (AR5) and kept as CO2e.

libraries.name: EXIOBASE 3
libraries.basis: Cradle-to-gate (total multipliers) per EUR 2019 of product at basic prices, by gas and region
libraries.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (v3.8.2). Note: v3.9 and later are non-commercial and are not used.
libraries.citation: Stadler, K. et al. (2021). EXIOBASE 3 (3.8.2). Zenodo. doi:10.5281/zenodo.5589597
libraries.note: Convert spend to EUR 2019 at basic prices. HFC and PFC are reported by EXIOBASE as CO2e. Derived factors are shared under CC BY-SA 4.0.

libraries.name: US Life Cycle Inventory (USLCI)
libraries.version: FY25 Q2 with US electricity baseline v1.2025-06.0
libraries.basis: Cradle-to-gate per reference unit, solved from unit processes with default providers (cut-off for unlinked inputs), by gas
libraries.licence: Repository under MIT licence; data is US federal content (confirm data terms before resale)
libraries.citation: Federal LCA Commons. U.S. Life Cycle Inventory Database (USLCI), FY25 Q2. National Renewable Energy Laboratory.
libraries.note: Carbon dioxide is not split into fossil and biogenic in the federal flow list; CO2 uptake (resource flows) is excluded. 3203 unlinked inputs were cut off.

libraries.name: AGRIBALYSE
libraries.basis: Pre-characterised climate change (EF 3.1, IPCC 2021 GWP100) per kg of food sold in France, farm to retail shelf (consumer stage excluded); stage split included
libraries.licence: Licence Ouverte / Open Licence (Etalab 2.0), attribution required
libraries.citation: ADEME, AGRIBALYSE v3.2 (Synthèse and Détail par étape), data.ademe.fr
libraries.note: CO2e = farm + processing + packaging + transport + retail; the consumer stage (storage, cooking) is left out. Values are already characterised, so the GWP method does not change them.

libraries.name: ecosystem WEEE LCI + recycled plastics from WEEE
libraries.basis: End-of-life treatment of electrical and electronic equipment (aggregated LCI), per reference unit, by gas
libraries.licence: ecosystem General Terms of Use: free use, modification and integration in LCA software; cite the source; unmodified data may only be redistributed free of charge
libraries.citation: ecosystem, WEEE LCI Database and Recycled plastics from WEEE LCI Database, weee-lci.ecosystem.eco
libraries.note: Amounts are per unit of each dataset's reference flow. Substitution benefits are included only where the dataset name says so.
libraries.modifications: Significantly modified under GTU V.c: only greenhouse-gas emissions to air are kept, summed over air sub-compartments and converted to CO2Trace gas keys; biogenic CO2 kept apart; ownership field removed; not in ILCD format.
libraries.originalData: Original data set, modelling details and GTU conditions: https://weee-lci.ecosystem.eco (datasets commissioned by ecosystem; WEEE LCI co-owned with ADEME; Modelling Principles Report and GTU there). Redistributed free of charge.
